remarks: Welcome to 179 Park Street A (or Unit 14) located in the Parkview Condominium Association in the heart of New Canaan. With three finished floors and over 2000 square feet, this end unit is light filled with 3 sides of windows overlooking the grassy yard and private terrace. The gracious entry opens to the spacious living room, dining room, powder room and eat in kitchen while the second floor has 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths. The master bathroom boasts a separate shower and soaking tub along with a large walk in closet. The lower level provides ample storage, a finished family room/playroom, small office and half bath. There is an assigned parking space and a one car garage. The location provides easy access to Mead Park through a private path from the complex. Enjoy all that downtown New Canaan has from this conveniently located sunny and spacious townhouse.
